prompt:
Create ONE new finished, highly detailed THREE MUSKETEERS trio comedy poster, reinterpreting the supplied approved artwork in the new setting described below. Use built-in image generation at the highest native detail available. This is a complete artwork, not a photographed poster mockup.

REFERENCE ROLES: Images1 and2 are the approved expanded-world panorama and zoom poster: PRIMARY continuity references for the THREE main characters, Anna's specific appearance, the golden dog and the tiny visual jokes. Image3 is the cozy relationship poster: supplementary character and warm mood reference. Image4 is real Brett, the glasses-wearing man on the LEFT; image5 is real Sean, the man on the RIGHT, supplementary facial-structure references that help keep them recognizable through imaginative styling. Keep the trio from the approved art identifiable while adapting clothing and expressions naturally to the setting. Anna is in the MIDDLE: same specific light-eyed brown-haired woman with glasses on her head, subtle nose jewelry, burgundy clothing, amused, expressive and fully part of the group. Do not substitute a generic blonde woman or merge the two men. Brett's rectangular glasses and light short hair/light facial stubble stay recognizable; Sean's dark swept/wavy hair, facial structure, stubble and broad laugh remain distinct. Exactly THREE full-size human adults, each appearing once, plus ONE friendly golden retriever with the HR harness/badge. No additional people or duplicate faces. Tiny nonhuman fantasy creatures such as snails are allowed.

THE CORE: affectionate roasting, practical care, creative ambition, gaming, everyday exhaustion and absurd ideas. All three are friends with agency; Anna can participate in the nonsense rather than always parent the men. The HR dog is delighted and takes his ridiculous role seriously. Main people retain equal dignity; humor is in absurd objects and shared situations. These are imaginative art scenes, not claims of real historical events. Rich small connected discoveries like the source: a tiny accident creates a paper trail; a snail family acquires legal files; game or coffee logistics spill into office bureaucracy. Visual jokes should be causally linked and adapted to this setting. Main faces and dog must remain much larger and clearer than the discoveries.

ART AND TYPE: beautiful believable portrait faces within an imaginative tactile photorealistic-surreal illustration. The source's playful sophistication and layered discoveries persist, but use the theme's palette, atmosphere and composition. First read title then faces/dog then medium jokes then tiny discoveries. Distinct depth planes, calm zones behind every text label, generous margins, crisp edges, coherent light, no noisy confetti over faces. Short exact text only, integrated into actual signs, mugs, cards and props with flat pale surfaces and dark ink; neon glow outside letter edges. Legible requested words before extra decoration. Do not copy a whole wall of small text from the references indiscriminately. No fake paragraphs, pseudo-writing or garbled lettering. Keep specified recurring wording verbatim, including PWAY when requested. Crude double meanings and profanity allowed, no slurs, explicit sexual content, sexual violence, self-harm imagery, real disasters, diagnostic claims or memorial motifs. Do not add watermarks, timestamps or camera UI. Natural hands, correct human anatomy, no obstructed faces. Change setting/poses enough that this is a distinct new theme rather than the same counter with a new background.

Wide16:9 panoramic secret group-chat laboratory with violet/cyan/magenta neon, warm gold metal and rich glass reflections. Not a copy of source composition: arrange trio in a broad semicircular workshop with Anna-middle mixing a harmless rainbow foaming experiment herself, smirking at Brett-left's mock-serious scientific note-taking; Sean-right holds a comically tiny fire extinguisher and laughs at the grandiosity. Golden HRdog in front stamps report with paw. Each human large, recognizable. Five miniature discovery zones: snail nursery leads to shell-shaped tiny court; rainbow tube feeds an incident-report printer; tiny espresso gravity well pulls sugar; arcade cable tangles with overdue files; small emergency pizza station. Crisp title "THREE MUSKETEERS"; subtitle "QUESTIONABLE RESEARCH". Medium labels "SCIENCE MAKES BETTER BAD DECISIONS", "ADULT SUPERVISION IS A PAID FEATURE", "BAD IDEA JUICE". Anna's flipped clipboard "NOT MY DEPARTMENT". Dog badge "HR"; little report "HR CASE #404". Two distinct machine buttons "FUCK AROUND" and "FIND OUT"; tiny treat tray "SETTLEMENT: TWO TREATS". Only harmless comic experiments, nobody hurt, no explicit drugs. Make the interactions and new arrangement genuinely fresh.

qa.notes: Three recognizable adults, Anna actively experiments; clear requested main/medium lettering; connected miniature scenes. Original generic golden HR dog will be superseded by a corrected sibling per new user reference. Tiny incident report has decorative pseudo-text.
